notes.title: Update Notes (Version 1.40 :: July 2nd, 2024)
notes.content:
Welcome, esteemed rulers of Egypt!

I've updated the game with several quality-of-life improvements and am currently upgrading materials, textures, and shaders.
Many new content ideas are still in the works, so stay tuned for more exciting updates!

Fixed Features[list]
[*] Fixed a setting that reactivated the AI when restarting a Custom Game with two human players (Thank you, Circé and Gregory!).
[*] Fixed the fade-to-black animation still having some light at the end.
[*] Fixed a rule mistake that sent the opponent's pawn to the House of Water (instead of the House of Beauty) when a pawn was going back from the House of Beauty.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the player from passing their turn when other pawns were on the last special houses beyond the House of Water.
[*] Fixed the French tutorial labels using incorrect versions.
[*] Fixed a gamepad issue in the main menu causing the options to change only by moving left or right.
[*] Fixed the main menu playing a sound when attempting to change an unchangeable option.
[*] Fixed the pause menu having a blank option.
[/list]
Updated Features[list]
[*] Updated the splash screen.
[*] Updated Tutankhamun's water bottle with improved material.
[*] Updated the main menu font for several European languages to be nicer and more consistent in size.
[*] Updated the cascade settings of shadows for an overall better result.
[*] Updated the tomb with improved texture by remapping all the UVs.
[*] Updated the Panehesy table model with ebony and ivory.
[*] Updated the main wood table with gold foil.
[*] Updated the pawn models of the tutorial board.
[*] Updated several main materials and textures inside the tomb scene with a new, improved shader. This is a first step, as I plan to update everything else afterward.
[*] Updated Imenmes board (Wood) with a new temporary shader.
[/list]
Added Features[list]
[*] Added torches, stairs, and sand inside the tomb scene (only visible on the highest settings).
[*] Added the headdress box of Tutankhamun found in his tomb.
[*] Added wooden vase stoppers on top of the vases.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes (Version 1.31 :: December 12th, 2023)
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers!

As the year rolls to a close, I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you who embarked on this epic journey with me. May your end of year games be filled with joy and epic victories! Wishing you a festive season overflowing with warmth and happiness.

Version 1.31:[list]
[*] Implemented the possibility in Easy and Normal to show/hide the Dice Tokens, as the help linked to it (Hard always hide them).
[*] Fixed the missing labels "Start New Campaign" in several languages.
[*] Fixed the emissive part of the shader of the Tokens (it was a little too dark since 1.30).
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes (Version 1.30 :: November 4, 2023)
notes.content:
Hello folks!

This patch mainly adds the possibility to save a game to resume it later.

In the pause menu select "Save & Quit" to save your game. When a save exists the main menu will show the option to resume the game. That option will disappear when you complete the game. You'll be able to resume the game on another device, like the Steam Deck, as the save files are sync on Steam Cloud.

Thank you for a phenomenal year of playing and supporting my game!

Version 1.30:[list]
[*] Implemented the possibility to save and resume a game for both the campaign and the custom game mode, each with its own unique save.
[*] Added a custom rule enabling the removal of the obligation to move backward when unable to move forward.
[*] Added an option to increase the animation speed for dice rolls and piece movements.
[*] Rectified several labels.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes (Version 1.20 :: April 21, 2023)
notes.content:
Hello there!

After the 1.10 improving things behind the scene, 1.20 is about improving things on the scene.

Version 1.20:[list]
[*] The main menu has been widened to allow labels twice as large. It will not affect performance. In fact, the textures have been optimized to be even slightly lighter.
[*] Expanded the language options by adding Japanese, Polish, Korean, Italian, and Dutch to the game, and Re-translated the entire game for the other languages.
[*] Added the Customizable Board, which allows players to mix and match all unlocked parts during a Custom Game. The actual boards found in museums vary in size, so for the purpose of the game, the selected pieces (pawns and dice) are scaled to fit the chosen board. This new feature offers a unique and personalized gameplay experience that I hope you will enjoy.
[*] Added an arrow on the House of Beauty on the Tutorial Board to better show that you can exit a pawn from here on a roll of 5.
[*] Modern Board :: You can now play a regular custom game using the tutorial board. Rules written on Aaru are masked and the default dice of the board is the Knucklebones.
[*] Inlaid Board :: New shader for the faience tiles, which adds a light glass effect.
[*] Wooden Board :: Updated the main Texture to contrast a little more the houses.
[*] Ivory Board :: Doubled the actual model size to increase the quality of the cascaded shadows on it, which are size-dependent.
[*] Ebony Board :: Now has several variant of pawns like other boards.
[/list]

Side notes:[list]
[*] Please note that with the introduction of the Customizable Board, there are now 4096 possible combinations. While I have tested the feature extensively, it's possible that some combinations may have slipped through the cracks. So, please don't hesitate to let me know if you come across any issues or anomalies, and I'll do my best to fix them as quickly as possible.
[*] If you come across anything else that seems unusual or out of the ordinary after the recent update, please don't hesitate to report it in the comments below as well. I will look into the issue as soon as possible and take any necessary steps to resolve it.
[*] Senet is a no-budget indie game and a one-man show. I do the translations mainly on the belief that something is better than nothing. If you happen to notice any errors or mistakes in the translations, I would be extremely grateful if you could report them in the comments below. As a native speaker, your input is incredibly valuable in helping me improve the game for all players. Thank you for your support and feedback!
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/666978085316329512/1096141023157174354/Senet-1.2-Preview.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes (Version 1.10 :: March 21, 2023)
notes.content:
Mainly a patch about improving things behind the scene, and fixing a few things discovered in the process.

[b]New feature[/b] allowing the player to play games by [b]moving a pawn after each throw of dice[/b] (in Settings/Rules). Kendall's rules do indeed allow all rolls to be made before moves, increasing the strategic component of the game but rarely used in commercial Senet.

Now you can choose between "[i]Throws then Moves[/i]" as before or "[i]Play each throw[/i]". Keep in mind that removing the ability to make move combinations will slightly decrease the difficulty, and the noticeable difference between Normal and Hard mode.

Please also note that this new feature and the chosen difficulty are not taken into account for the tutorial, whose goal is to learn the main Kendall rules during a short easy game with 3 pieces.

Version 1.10:[list]
[*] New faster loading system.
[*] New and better settings system.
[*] Moved Display settings into Graphics to make room for the new Rule options.
[*] Added the possibility to force to play each move after each throw of the dice (for both Campaign games and Custom games).
[*] Fixed an issue that could prevent saving a language other than the default one in Steam.
[*] Fixed a missing label in the menus in simplified Chinese.
[*] Fixed an untranslated label in the controls in simplified Chinese.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes (Version 1.01) for Nov 8
notes.content:
Version 1.01:[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could occur when the AI was not able to play a move, and led to the token visual staying on the screen (thanks to [i]Pandamy[/i] for the report and testing).
[*] Fixed a bug that could occur when the player was on the House of Water and led to being able to accidentally pass your turn (thanks to [i]Memnon[/i] for the report).
[*] Fixed the wrong focal of the camera on the Steam Deck, which was too wide.
[*] Updated the Tutorial (House 27, 28, 29 and 30) to add more details about what actually happen when you have a pawn on the House of Water (your other pawns are not defended anymore and they can't move).
[*] Added a mean to avoid having way too much random luck. The same math method with the same odds is actually used for both the player and the AI. The AI does not get any advantage at all, even in Hard (the player has, by starting first with his pawns ahead). The dice result is fully random, in fact it was a little too much random, so I fixed that. It's no more the case, overall the dice results will be more fair for everyone, and actually very close.
[*] Added two debug log lines in the Unity log file (in AppData), printing the dice stats of both players.[/list]

notes.title: Senet
notes.content:
During this second Stream you'll be able to follow three different games at the same time (switching from one to another almost every 2 minutes):
[list]
[*] Amunmes Wood Board :: Normal difficulty, marked board using throwsticks.
[*] Tutankhamun Ivory Board :: Normal+ difficulty as this genuine board found in his tomb is not marked on the Senet Side and was found with Knucklebones in its drawer.
[*] Amunhotep III Faience Board :: Hard difficulty, which means no HUD to help you.
[/list]

Board game from ancient Egypt, [i]Senet[/i] is a [b]turn-based strategy game[/b] meant for two players. Meaning “[i]The Game of Passing[/i]”, and associated with spiritual and religious practices, [i]Senet[/i] is one of the oldest racing games of humankind and was played by the Pharaohs themselves. In the Book of the Dead, Senet is used to play our destiny in the afterlife to access the kingdom of Osiris. Are you going to try yours?
